NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2025
Source: NVIDIA Corporation, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (filed with the SEC, Feb. 26, 2025)
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000021/q4fy25pr.htm

SANTA CLARA, Calif. Feb. 26, 2025. NVIDIA today reported revenue for the fourth quarter ended January 26, 2025, of $39.3 billion, up 12% from the previous quarter and up 78% from a year ago.

For the quarter, GAAP earnings per diluted share was $0.89, up 14% from the previous quarter and up 82% from a year ago. Non-GAAP earnings per diluted share was $0.89, up 10% from the previous quarter and up 71% from a year ago.

For fiscal 2025, revenue was $130.5 billion, up 114% from a year ago. GAAP earnings per diluted share was $2.94, up 147% from a year ago. Non-GAAP earnings per diluted share was $2.99, up 130% from a year ago.

NVIDIA will pay its next quarterly cash dividend of $0.01 per share on April 2, 2025, to all shareholders of record on March 12, 2025.

NVIDIA's outlook for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 is as follows. Revenue is expected to be $43.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 70.6% and 71.0%, respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $5.2 billion and $3.6 billion, respectively. GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates are expected to be 17.0%, plus or minus 1%, excluding any discrete items.

Data Center fourth-quarter revenue was a record $35.6 billion, up 16% from the previous quarter and up 93% from a year ago. Full-year Data Center revenue rose 142% to a record $115.2 billion.

Fourth-quarter Gaming revenue was $2.5 billion, down 22% from the previous quarter and down 11% from a year ago. Full-year Gaming revenue rose 9% to $11.4 billion.

Professional Visualization fourth-quarter revenue was $511 million, up 5% from the previous quarter and up 10% from a year ago. Full-year Professional Visualization revenue rose 21% to $1.9 billion.

Automotive fourth-quarter revenue was $570 million, up 27% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago. Full-year Automotive revenue rose 55% to $1.7 billion.

GAAP gross margin was 73.0% for the quarter, down 1.6 points from the previous quarter and down 3.0 points from a year ago. Non-GAAP gross margin was 73.5% for the quarter, down 1.5 points from the previous quarter.

GAAP operating income was $24.0 billion for the quarter, up 10% from the previous quarter and up 77% from a year ago. Non-GAAP operating income was $25.5 billion for the quarter, up 10% from the previous quarter.

GAAP net income was $22.1 billion for the quarter, up 14% from the previous quarter and up 80% from a year ago. Non-GAAP net income was $22.1 billion for the quarter, up 10% from the previous quarter.

Free cash flow was $15.5 billion for the quarter, down from $16.8 billion in the previous quarter.

For fiscal 2025, GAAP gross margin was 75.0%, up 2.3 points from a year ago. GAAP operating income was $81.5 billion for the year, up 147% from a year ago. GAAP net income was $72.9 billion for the year, up 145% from a year ago.

Full-year free cash flow was $60.7 billion.
